title: Philly Pulls Off the Heist: Commissioner Sonny Hands Team Pillbert the Keys to the Title Race
dek: Ahead of Week 6, Sonny shipped Chuba Hubbard and DeVonta Smith to Alan for George Pickens and Ollie Gordon II, and the title odds say the league villain just got a lot more dangerous.
body: Somewhere, ominous organ music is playing. Before Week 6 kicked off, The Horse is Hea (Sonny) and Team Pillbert (Alan) agreed to a two-for-two swap: Sonny sends RB Chuba Hubbard and WR DeVonta Smith to Philliberto, and gets back WR George Pickens and RB Ollie Gordon II. On the surface it is a tidy little running back and receiver exchange. Underneath, it looks a lot like the bad guy just walked out of the bank with the vault.

Start with what Alan landed. Hubbard came in with 74 points through five weeks, the biggest number in the whole deal, and Smith added 39 more. That is 113 combined points of production heading to Team Pillbert, and the projection models responded like they had just seen the final scene of a horror movie: Phillibert's title odds jumped from 15% to 27%. The league's resident jerk is now a legitimate contender, and he did it by trading with the guy who runs the league.

Now Sonny's side. Pickens arrives with 55 points over five weeks, a solid receiver haul, and Ollie Gordon II brings 31.8 points but has only been on a roster for two weeks, which makes him more of a lottery ticket than a locked-in starter. Add it up and Sonny took on 86.8 points of production while giving away 113. The odds were not kind: The Horse is Hea dropped from 18% to 10% to win Buckaroo Bowl IV. Maybe Sonny sees something in Gordon that the numbers don't, but for now, the horse is here and the title chances are leaving.

Who won it on paper? This isn't close. A 12-point swing up for Alan and an 8-point slide for Sonny is a clean sweep for Team Pillbert, and the defending champion just made the league's villain stronger. For a commissioner whose redemption arc took him from back-to-back last places to Buckaroo Bowl III, this is a strange way to defend the crown. Abuse of power was supposed to work the other way, Commish.

The real story is what happens next. If Gordon breaks out and Pickens keeps stacking points, Sonny gets to say he bought low before anyone else noticed. If Hubbard keeps rolling for Philly, this trade gets framed and hung in the Team Pillbert lair. Either way, the rest of the league now has a scarier Alan to deal with, and they have their commissioner to thank.

social.author: Buckaroo Trade Desk
social.text: TRADE ALERT: Hubbard + DeVonta Smith to Team Pillbert. Pickens + Ollie Gordon II to The Horse is Hea. Title odds: Alan 15% to 27%, Sonny 18% to 10%. Somebody check on the commish.

social.author: Pillbert Nation
social.text: Villains don't ask for permission. They ask for 113 points of production and get it. 27% and climbing. Boo us, we love it.

social.author: Horse is Hea Faithful
social.text: Everyone laughing now. Ollie Gordon II has been rostered for two weeks. Give the man time. Our guy went 13-3 last year, we trust the process (please, Sonny, have a process).

social.author: The Buckaroo Insider
social.text: Sources tell me the rest of the league is now demanding a commissioner review of a trade the commissioner lost. First time in league history the conspiracy theory runs backwards.

social.author: Waiver Wire Wally
social.text: Sonny gave up 113 points and got 86.8 back. Even JMoney's spreadsheet is filing a complaint.
